steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sora, are you alright?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yes, I'm fine.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Are you going after Texas?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: When I saw her a minute ago, she told me to wait for her.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Let's hunker down until this mess blows over. It's total mayhem out there.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: If you don't want to lose her, you're gonna wanna go after her.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Lappland...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I feel like it's the same with Lappland.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: For people like her, there's no point trying to guess at what they're thinking. It's better to just accept what they say at face value.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Only if every word they say is true can you start to figure if they're ultimately trying to weave truths into a lie.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Why's that?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Well, do you know who it is waiting in that room?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Giovanna Rossati.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: If there's anyone who could actually get Texas to come back to Siracusa...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It ain't me, or Bernardo. And it sure as hell isn't Signora Sicilia.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It's her, Giovanna.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Cellinia, you're a lot taller than you used to be.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Makes sense, doesn't it? It's been years.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: By the way, I met some of your friends from Lungmen. Your name came up a few times, and from what they said, I can tell they're worried about you.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...I didn't think they'd come here.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: You're nothing like them, at all. I never thought you'd make such lively, outgoing friends with that personality of yours.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You don't count?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: If you really thought I was your friend, you wouldn't have gone so long without writing me.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Alright. I know you must be hiding something else.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Nothing much.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: The liquidation came too suddenly. None of Columbia's famiglie could sleep at night. I couldn't bear to see that any longer, so I stood up to take charge of the situation.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I opened up talks with Signora Sicilia, and we basically managed to sort things out.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: That's all there is to it.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You make it sound so easy.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Honestly, I should be complaining to you.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: But it's been too long since I've had anyone to confide in.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: So that's why you poured your heart and soul into your scripts.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Haha, could you tell? 'La Morte di Texas' my magnum opus.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: There were some details in it that only you'd know.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I guess that means my memory's pretty good then.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: But, I could never decide on what to do with Act III, with your 'death.'

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I guess there's no need to think about it anymore.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Actually, becoming a playwright had another purpose. It's an open secret that Bernardo passed responsibility for the famiglia to his son, while he went on to become the artistic director of his troupe, Compagnia dell'alba.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I wanted a chance to meet him. You know, there aren't many mafiosi who would do something like that.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: But the one who ended up shattering all expectations, was him.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I guess I should've expected it after all, from the man who built Famiglia Bellone into what it is in just a single generation.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: By the looks of things, he really wants to challenge Signora Sicilia.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You don't seem worried about it.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: All I can say is, if Bernardo considers you his trump card against the Rossatis, he's counting his fowlbeasts before they've hatched.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: You were right to come to me, Cellinia.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: No matter what's going on between you and the Bellones, I can help you.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Join me.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: The two of us, together, will make a difference in Siracusa.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: And not just because you're Salvadore's granddaughter.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Because I know you, Cellinia. You can make a difference.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: We'll start over together, Cellinia.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Don't you want to know how I managed to survive?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Giovanna, it was no fluke that I survived the liquidation.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: So you're here, standing on this stage, performing this play... How much do you know about what happened seven years ago?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Seven years ago... Texas's father, Giuseppe, murdered his own father, Salvadore, and declared that the Texases would no longer operate under Siracusa's control.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That upset Signora Sicilia, who sent an elite force from the Twelve Families to Columbia to 'liquidate' the Texas Family.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You were part of that, weren't you?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Look who's such a smarty.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: At the time, Cellinia Texas was a star-studded name. She was Columbian, but even the Siracusans had nothing but wonderful things to say about her.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: This whole time... you've been trying to beat Texas?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Beat her?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: No, no, no.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Back when the Saluzzos were looking after her, we were pretty competitive.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Sometimes I'd win our little contests, sometimes I'd lose.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I did want to beat her, but that had nothing to do with what happened later.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Then...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You certainly do care deeply for her.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Unfortunately, that has nothing to do with the plot of the story either.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: At least tell me what happened.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I joined in the liquidation.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I was fantasizing about how she would fight me to the death for the sake of her famiglia. It got my heart pounding and my blood racing.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But, nothing could've prepared me for what I saw that day.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You're a hitman too, aren't you, Danbrown?

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Signorina Lavinia, seven years ago, I was part of the team that carried out the liquidation of Famiglia Texas.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: I arrived in the city ahead of time, took up a job at a carwash, and secretly observed the Texases' every move.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Then, the team from Siracusa arrived.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: And a group of Columbians found me.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Columbian mafiosi are pretty careless. Real full of themselves.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: I could've dealt with them easy enough, if it wasn't for that one girl.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: I knew her. She was a Texas, but everyone said she was like a Siracusan.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: ...Cellinia.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: When I see you, I'm sometimes reminded of her.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Was she as stupid as me, rambling on about ideals with a murderer?

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Signorina Lavinia.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: I never meant to make fun of your ideals. It's just... I can barely believe it.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Hearing you talk about that stuff... it's like listening to a real pretty fairy tale.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: To me, your ideals are so pretty, they're a kind of shortcut to get me a good night's sleep.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: That day, I was ready to fight for my life.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: I was convinced she would see right through me.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: She let me walk right by her, just like this.
The audience has scattered in every direction. The battle between murderers has moved on.
The theater has emptied out.
As Lappland speaks, she takes light dance steps out onto the empty stage.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The associates of Famiglia Texas were already pretty much wiped out.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But, what about Cellinia?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: She was the only one missing.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: We couldn't let anyone live to talk about what happened, especially not the eldest daughter. So, we all went to track her down.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And that was when chaos broke out.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The Texas mansion went up in flames, burning away the famiglia's very existence.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And the arsonist... was standing there at the front door.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Right in front of me.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: She slowly turned and walked towards me.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: At that moment, I understood.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: She decided to stand by and watch the end of her own famiglia.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But who could blame her?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Her father murdered her grandfather, and didn't want to be an accomplice to that.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Only she had the right to blame herself.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But, there's more to it than that.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: When I looked into her eyes, what I saw was—

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Exhaustion.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Cellinia's story... is no secret to Famiglia Saluzzo, or to me.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: After all, the one who led the Saluzzo team at the time was none other than Signorina Lappland.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: She got kicked out because she went out on her own to hunt down Cellinia. Her men got caught up in a counterattack, and a lot of them died.
I won't run away, nor will I avert my eyes.
For so long, she has told herself as much.
But this time, her words fail her.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Look at the bodies on the street, Lavinia. Listen to the shouts and cries in the distance.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: What can you do?

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: The only advice I can give you is the same I gave to Cellinia.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Run.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: The farther, the better.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Even if your past is going to catch up to you, you'll at least enjoy a moment of peace.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Otherwise— you will die.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But, I...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I still don't want to.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Her past kicked down her door.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It might've been against her will at first, but she was forced out only to find nothing changed—

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Maybe she'll decide the things she ran away from weren't actually all that bad.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Her life in Lungmen... might've been a slightly extended vacation.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And now, the one most intimately connected with her family and her past... is standing right in front of her.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That's what you wanted to tell me, right?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: If that's the case... I will respect her decision.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Even though you're her best friend?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Because I'm her best friend.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Darn tootin'.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Unless— the pizza in Siracusa becomes inedible.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: My grandfather was a sentimental man. He sent me to Siracusa, hoping I would remember my roots.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I lived there for a while.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: People there told me all the time that I fit in, like a Siracusan.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But for me, I was just doing what I'd always been doing.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The way I lived my life in Columbia was no different than the way I lived in Siracusa.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And what I saw in Siracusa was no different from what I saw in Columbia.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You might know the story of Famiglia Texas like the back of your hand, but I saw it with my own eyes.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Life isn't a play where every move is sprinkled with a little heroism or villainy. What happened was just an undignified slaughter.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: My father bought a counterfeit gun from Blacksteel. When he pulled the trigger, it exploded and did a number on him.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: My grandfather fell to the ground. My father drew his knife with his injured hand, but the first stab went wide.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I heard everything from the doorway. Hoarse curses, groans of pain...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The commotion lasted for a long time before it finally ended.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: In that moment, I was exhausted. Exhausted with everything.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: So I decided to leave.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Are you telling me that Lungmen is your home now?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I don't know. I can't say for sure.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But, I at least know I had a pretty good time there.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: You're just like you were back then. Blunt, and straight to the point.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Looks like I'm the one getting ahead of myself.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Here I was thinking you came to ask for my help.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Or at least, you'd want to catch up with me.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: But in the end, you're here to tell me... that we can never go back—

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: You know, Cellinia, that's awfully heartless of you.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I was shocked when I heard you were still alive.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: But you went ahead and stamped out my hope, all over again.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm sorry, Giovanna.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I don't want to be Siracusan, or Columbian.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I just want to be Cellinia Texas.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: This is your last chance.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: If you walk through those doors, you'll be my enemy. The Rossatis' enemy.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: You'll be in our way, and I, as Donna Rossati, have a responsibility to eliminate everything that stands in our way.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Don't make me do this.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We're just too sentimental, Giovanna.
